title: FBI Photo B009
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: grayscale targeting/surveillance display with crosshair overlay
pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or thermal camera display. A white crosshair reticle is centered, with a horizontal measurement scale marked at intervals labeled 15, 10, 5, 0, 5, 10, 15 extending left and right of center, and tick marks along the vertical axis. The background is a noisy gray gradient. Multiple black rectangular bars (resembling redaction blocks) are placed symmetrically around the frame: two large bars at mid-height left and right, a wide black bar across the top, and additional bars at lower left, lower right, and center-left and center-right positions. A small black dot appears left of center. A white timestamp is overlaid in the lower-left corner. The bottom edge shows faint darker gradient shapes.
